autoSave.description: General--Automatically save the content being edited.

autoSaveDelay.description: General--The time in ms after a change that the file is saved.

titleBarStyle.description: General--The title bar style (Windows and Linux system only).

openFilesInNewWindow.description: General--Open files in a new window.

openFolderInNewWindow.description: General--Open folder via menu in a new window.

zoom.description: General--The zoom level. Between 0.5 and 2.0 inclusive.

wordWrapInToc.description: General--Whether to enable word wrap in TOC.

fileSortBy.description: General--Sort files in opened folder by created time, modified time and title.

fileSortOrder.description: General--Sort order for files in opened folders: ascending or descending.

lastOpenedFolder.description: General--The last folder that was opened in MarkText.--internal

startUpAction.description: General--The action after MarkText startup, open the last opened folder, open the specified folder or blank page

defaultDirectoryToOpen.description: General--The default directory that should be opened on startup when startUp=folder.

editorLineWidth.description: Editor--Defines the maximum editor area width. An empty string or suffixes of ch (characters), px (pixels) or % (percentage) are allowed.

codeFontSize.description: Editor--Font size in code Block, the range is 12 ~ 18

codeFontFamily.description: Editor--Font family used in code block

hideQuickInsertHint.description: Editor--Hide hint for quickly creating paragraphs

hideLinkPopup.description: Editor--Hide link popup when the cursor is hover on the link

autoCheck.description: Editor--Whether to automatically check related task.

theme.description: Theme--Select the theme used in MarkText

followSystemTheme.description: Theme--Use separate theme in dark mode.

lightModeTheme.description: Theme--Theme to use when system is in light mode.

restoreLayoutState.description: General--Restore previous editor state on startup.

darkModeTheme.description: Theme--Theme to use when system is in dark mode.

customCss.description: Custom CSS--Custom CSS to apply to the current theme.--internal

imageInsertAction.description: Image--The default behavior after insert image from local folder

imagePreferRelativeDirectory.description: Image--Whether to prefer the relative image directory.

sideBarVisibility.description: View--Whether the side bar is visible.--internal

sourceCodeModeEnabled.description: View--Whether the source-code mode is enabled by default.--internal

openedFilesInSidebar.description: General--Whether to show opened files in the sidebar.

searchExclusions.description: Searcher--List of glob patterns to exclude from search.--internal

searchMaxFileSize.description: Searcher--The maximal file size (<maxFileSize><suffix>). Suffixes of K, M or G are allowed if not suffix is given the number is treated as bytes.--internal

searchIncludeHidden.description: Searcher--Whether to search in hidden files and directories.--internal

searchNoIgnore.description: Searcher--Whether to ignore ignore files like .gitignore.--internal

watcherUsePolling.description: Watcher--Whether to use polling. Polling may leads to high CPU utilization but is necessary to watch files over a network.--internal
